Spotify’s iOS tests found users clicked 9% more overall and 30% more on menu items with a tab bar, and the new bar encouraged more exploration without hurting retention or consumption time [d1][d6]. Other snippets attribute this to lower discoverability and extra taps, and one example says Zeebox’s engagement “halved” after switching to a hamburger menu [d3][d5].
